items.name: denomsClearable_of_natDegree_le

items.name: denomsClearable_C_mul_X_pow

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S₁ : Type v} →
    {σ : Type u_1} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] → [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] → (R →+* S₁) → (σ → S₁) → MvPolynomial σ R →+* S₁

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁)
  (g : σ → S₁) (p : MvPolynomial σ R), MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g p = (MvPolynomial.eval g) ((MvPolynomial.map f) p)

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S₁ : Type v} →
    {σ : Type u_1} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] →
        [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] → [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁] → (σ → S₁) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] S₁

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (g : R →+* S₁)
  (X : σ → S₁) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ g X f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, g (MvPolynomial.coeff d f) * ∏ i ∈ d.support, X i ^ d i
